body:
Follows up `accel-lut`'s next step: both engines in Verilog, bit-exact against NumPy (Icarus), synthesised with Yosys to generic gates. Negative and stylised: the table engine needs an accumulator per output, so its datapath is 2.4x to 11.6x the MAC engine's and it takes 1.1x to 3.0x the cycles. Random weights, area only, no energy measured; all caveats in the README.

Checks run locally: 4 tests pass, `python site/build.py` prints ok.
